candidates.change_summary: Removed the require(msg.sender == owner) check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Removed the require(receiver != address(0)) check so transfers to the zero address are allowed.
Removed the require(amount > 0) check so zero-value calls to sendTo succeed instead of reverting.
Delete the ownership check so any caller can invoke sendTo.
Delete the zero-address check so transfers to address(0) are allowed.
Delete the positive-amount check so zero-amount transfers succeed.
Delete the transfer statement so no Ether is sent and no transfer revert can occur.
Invert the ownership comparison so only non-owners can call sendTo.
Replace the transfer with a low-level call whose return value is ignored, forwarding remaining gas and not reverting on failure.
Delete the ownership check require(msg.sender == owner), allowing anyone to call sendTo.
Delete the check require(receiver != address(0)), allowing transfers to the zero address (a successful burn) which originally reverted.
Delete the check require(amount > 0), allowing zero-value transfers which originally reverted.
Replace the transfer target receiver with msg.sender, sending funds back to the caller instead of the receiver.
Replace the transferred amount with the constant 1, so calls sending amounts other than 1 wei transfer a different value.
Move require(amount > 0) to after the transfer, so a zero-amount transfer is executed before the require reverts, exposing different observable outcomes (revert vs success) for amount == 0.
Removed the require(msg.sender == owner) check so any caller can trigger the transfer.
Removed the require(amount > 0) check so a zero-amount transfer to a valid receiver now succeeds.
Removed the require(receiver != address(0)) check so transfers to address(0) are now allowed.
Changed the transferred amount from `amount` to the constant `1`, altering the value sent.
